title: Buying the clarinet and Presley Goff's help
summary: He pawned an alto sax, and Presley Goff taught him the scale on clarinet; he picked it up quickly.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Can you tell us about when you first took up the clarinet? You say you heard George Bocquet and he inspired you to take it up. Yeah, that's right. That's right. Where did you get the clarinet and when and all?

Well, I... I happened to buy a... And... Uh... I... 된... 된... 된... ! They bought me alto sax when I was playing clarinet. I pawned that and I never could get it out any time before I got it out. I pawned it one carnival. I didn't play, you know. I didn't worry about it. I couldn't get it out. So he just bought my ticket. Just like now, I'm playing clarinet, but you know, after I couldn't get going with a good trumpet player, well I just, you know, I mean this rock and roll stuff come out, well I don't fall for that kind of stuff and just make me forget about it, you know.
Do you have any lessons on clarinet? Anybody help you?
The boy Presley Goff, he used to be down on Tulu Street, he's in Tibbetul. He played music too, you know. Presley Goff.
And he helped you some with the clarinet?
He learned me to scale. He learned how to play clarinet himself.
How long did it take you to play the clarinet?
Oh it didn't take me long. That's what I'm saying now, it didn't take me long. After I learned to scale.
You went out on the job then pretty soon.
